metric: Browser per-run handler start to checked visible update
unit: seconds in summaries; original milliseconds retained per run
scope: 69 historical measured bounded-edit requests, 4 initial/filmed CLI rehearsals and 4 direct-API rehearsals. Canvas development calls and connectivity tests are outside this comparison index.
rules: Do not pool cohorts or direct API rehearsals into the historical measured sets.
Historical Astra means requested GPT-6 Astra through Codex CLI; no served-model identity is reported.
Direct API responses confirm both requested model identities; only low effort has been tested through both direct APIs.
Equal requested effort labels do not imply equal internal compute or capability.
CLI timings include startup and wrapper instructions; they are not the same-path direct-API comparison.
The initial 45-run primary summary stays task-specific. Its optional task-mixture statistic is descriptive, not a same-task repeat median.
The effort sweep uses one observation per task/condition, so its basket median is not repeated-trial uncertainty.
Source and DOM checks are not independent content correctness. Historical pass flags are AI-assisted, not human or blind.
New API records remain rehearsal/review:pending and are shown as individual checked-visible observations, not reviewed benchmark aggregates.
No measured decode tokens/second, TTFT, hardware-only speedup, general coding quality or reliability is established.
qualityCaveats: Initial GPT-OSS low T2: all five notes pass the minimum contract but offer a sparse explanation.
Effort sweep Qwen high T2: pass with sparse-explanation caveat; high effort did not establish better teaching quality.
Separate Canvas showcase required explicit feedback to correct prose. These bounded-edit results do not remove that failure.
